manifestProvider:
<!-- Agent Bridge auto-init (manifest-merged; boots with no app code). Place inside <application>. -->
<provider
    android:name="com.example.coldrun.AgentBridgeInitProvider"
    android:authorities="${applicationId}.agentbridge"
    android:exported="false"
    android:enabled="true" />
integration: 1. Write both .kt files to the paths above.
2. Merge the <provider> snippet into the app's AndroidManifest.xml inside <application>. (Auto-inits the AGENT_CMD receiver at process start — no app code needed.)
3. (Optional, for scene introspection) after building your scene root, add one line: AgentBridge.attachScene(sceneRoot) — e.g. in HomeStage right after the SpatialView content is built.
driveExamples: adb -s emulator-5554 shell am broadcast -a <applicationId>.AGENT_CMD --es cmd ping
adb -s emulator-5554 shell am broadcast -a <applicationId>.AGENT_CMD --es cmd scene_stats
adb -s emulator-5554 shell am broadcast -a <applicationId>.AGENT_CMD --es cmd dump_scene --ei depth 8
adb -s emulator-5554 logcat -d -s AgentBridge:V   # read the AGENTBRIDGE| markers
verification: COMPILES against the SDK (assembleDebug). RUNTIME is headlessly verifiable via adb broadcast + logcat (unlike rendering) — assert the AGENTBRIDGE| markers. Pairs with assert_logcat.
